pol.title: Policies & texts
pol.sub: The help pages that carry your policies: terms, exchange, delivery, privacy and more. Numbers come from Smart Rules, so a window or a charge is never written twice.

kpi.allShow: Every page has something to say
kpi.ownFoot: Empty pages read only their rules
kpi.tokensHidden: {n} line(s) hidden until their rule is live

now.noRules: No rules: the page says only your words.
now.tokens: Rule numbers in your words on this page

card.d: Switch the page, pick the rules it reads, and write your own words in both languages. Leave the words empty to show only the rules.
card.rules: Smart Rules this page reads (their texts, in order)
card.detailsHelp: Contact: e-mail and hotline. Legal: registered name, address, trade licence and DBID (from Store details).
card.titleHelp: Empty: the shop's own title for this page.
card.bodyHelp: An empty line starts a new paragraph, "## " a heading, "- " a list line. Quote a rule's number as {exchange.windowHours}: see the list below.

values.d: Copy a token into your words. The shop writes the rule's value in its place, and leaves the line out while the rule is not live.
values.none: No Smart Rules yet. Add one in Smart Rules, then quote its numbers here.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this page; it shows their version now.
err.PLACEHOLDER: Your words still hold a stand-in like [number] or TBD ({fields}). Write the real words, or quote a rule's number.
err.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: These tokens name no rule value: {fields}. Use a token from the list below.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.

pol.readOnly: You can see these pages; changing them needs the settings permission.
pol.pairHelp: Write both languages, or leave both empty.
